{{Ahn|exclusive=yes}} {{Infobox/Character |dont_submit_to_bucket = Yes |location=Village |x=2 |y=77 |z=-5 }} '''Centauri''' is an [[NPC]] exclusive to the [[Alpha Hypixel Network|Alpha Network]]. They are located in front of the {{zone|Community Center}}, and grant {{c}}, {{Item|Booster Cookie}}s, item upgrades and update-featured items. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Usage == '''Centauri''' can be accessed by talking to them in the Hub, or via the {{code|/centauri}} command anywhere. The interface has three parts. === Featured Update Items === {{Quote|Claim featured items related to this update.}} This menu is a shop that sells items featured in an update for {{Coins|1}} each. === Coin Generator === This menu gives player any amount of money. Available options are: {{Coins|1k}}, {{Coins|10k}}, {{Coins|100k}}, {{Coins|1m}}, {{Coins|10m}}, {{Coins|100m}}, {{Coins|1b}}, and "Custom Amount". === Toy Box === {{Quote|A variety of useful and cheaty utilities to make your life easier!}} This menu contains other features available to the player. These features applies an effect to a player, and are claimable for any amount of times and without cool down. {| class="wikitable" ! Feature !! Description |- | Cookie Jar | When clicked, it gives the player the effect of a {{Item|Booster Cookie}}, as if the player has consumed one.
Duration granted: {{Green|292,471,155 years, 208 days, 9 hours and 15 minutes}} in real-life time |- | Potion Seller | When clicked, it gives the player all potion effects of a {{Item|God Potion}}, as if the player has consumed one.
Duration granted: {{Green|292,471,155 years, 208 days, 9 hours and 15 minutes}} in real-life time |- | Max Items | When clicked, it makes the following changes to all armor pieces and items in the player's inventory (not including items in [[Storage]] and [[Wardrobe]]) if applicable: * Maximum [[Enchantments]] * [[Recombobulator 3000#Usage|Recombobulate]] * A fixed [[Reforge]] depending on the item's type, overriding any existing reforge on the item. If there is no set reforge for that category, the previous reforge, if any, stays on the item. Currently, this feature does not change any [[Gemstone]] slot on items. |- | Duplicate Items | When clicked when holding an item, it duplicates the item in the player's inventory. |- | Max Collections | When clicked, for all [[Collection]] items that has not reached its maximum tier, the collection amount is set to the requirement for the highest tier, meaning all tiers are unlocked. |- | Max Skills | When clicked, for all [[Skills]] that has not reached its maximum level except {{Skill|Dungeoneering}}, its skill XP is set to an arbitrarily high number, meaning all levels are unlocked. |- | Max Slayers | When clicked, all [[Slayer|Slayers]] are increased to their maximum level. |- | 50k HOTM EXP | When clicked, the player instantly gains 50,000 [[HotM Experience|HotM EXP]]. |- | Big 'ol chunk o' Powder! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 2,000,000 [[Mithril Powder|Mithril]] and [[Gemstone Powder|Gemstone]] powder. |- | 5k Gems | When clicked, the player's [[Gems]] purse is set to {{Green|5,000}}. |- | Set RNG Meter Progress | When clicked, the player is prompted to enter an amount of XP for all the player's [[RNG Meter]]s progress to be set to. |- | Clear RNG Meter Progress | When clicked, the player's RNG Meters' progress is set to 0. |- | Fill Agatha's Rewards | Gives you rewards for [[Agatha]]'s contests as if you had participated in 25 of them. |- | Big 'ol chunk o' Whispers! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 1,000,000 {{Turquoise|Forest Whispers}}. |- | Shards! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 10 of every available {{Item|Attribute Shard}}. |- |} ==== Reforges ==== '''Centauri''' applies the following reforges when using Max Items: {| class="wikitable centertext" |- ! Make sure to talk to Sam on your private island to go to the Garden if you are at least SkyBlock level 5!}} |- | class="ct" rowspan="2" | After finishing [[Sam]]'s introduction | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &8&lCentauri&r: Welcome.}} |- | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &8&lCentauri&r: Hello There.}} |} == Trivia == *'''Centauri''''s comments when the player claims potion effects is a reference to the infamous [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R_FQU4KzN7A potion seller meme]. *'''Centauri''''s skin is based off [https://www.destinypedia.com/Xûr Xûr] from the Destiny franchise. *'''Centauri''' and the fact that they are exclusive to the [[Alpha Hypixel Network|Alpha Network]] is a reference to the triple star system [[w:Alpha Centauri|Alpha Centauri]]. *The line "I solemnly swear I am up to no good.", despite not being verbatim, comes from Harry Potter, where it was used to access the [[fandom:harrypotter:Marauder's_Map#Usage|Marauder's Map]]. *The max collection feature works for [[Jacob's Farming Contest]]s and can be clicked multiple times to max the collections over and over. *The maximum number of coins that can be generated at once is 2^{63}-1 = 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 (9.223 quintillion or 9.223372e+18), which is the 64-bit signed integer limit. Attempting to generate more coins than this will cap it to this value. However, this can be repeated multiple times, and the player's purse can hold more than that. *It is possible to generate a negative amount of coins, which will take coins from your purse instead of adding to it. **It used to be possible to make your purse go negative with this, but that appears to have been patched. *You can duplicate an item even if your inventory is full. It will appear to succeed, but it will actually silently fail rather than being added to your [[Item Stash]] or [[Material Stash]]. == Gallery == Centauri (Pickaxe).png|'''Centuari''' during the Modernized Mining [[Alpha Hypixel Network|Alpha]] == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2023/Jan 26|[[File:Centauri.png|26px]] Added '''Centauri'''.|Featured Items has [[Garden]]-related items for this update.}} {{History|2023/May 4|Added {{Abbr|'''3'''|These are Duplicate Item, Max Collections, and Max Skills.}} more utilities in the Toy Box.}} {{History|0.19.8|Max Skills now also maxes {{skill|Catacombs}} skill.}} {{History|2024/Jan 29|Alpha Hypixel Network opens without '''Centauri''' appearing.}} {{History|2024/Jan 31|Alpha Hypixel Network opens with '''Centauri''' appearing again.|Added Max Slayers option in Toy Box.|Featured Items has {{Item|God Potion}}s and [[Mixins]] for this update.}} {{History|2024/March 21|Alpha Hypixel Network opens with '''Centauri''' once again returning|Added 50k HOTM EXP and Big Ol' chunk o' Powder!
